clue.text: Talking rubbish, shouting loudly, having penned article

indicators.note: the loud word holds the article within it, as a pen holds animals

parts.note: blaring is making a loud harsh noise
the definite article of English grammar

explanation.surface: Someone yelling nonsense at the top of their voice while carrying an article they have written.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Penned' suggests writing the article, but here it means enclosing.
explanation.definitionFit: To blather is to chatter on foolishly at length, so blathering is speaking nonsense.

clue.text: German chemist's spoken nonsense

indicators.note: the chemist's surname is to be heard rather than read, giving a word that sounds identical

parts.note: Carl Bosch, the German chemist of the Haber-Bosch ammonia process

explanation.surface: Dismissing what a German scientist said as rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: Carl Bosch was the German chemist who industrialised ammonia synthesis; his name is said the same as the slang word.
explanation.definitionFit: Bosh is an informal exclamation or noun meaning foolish talk or rubbish.

clue.text: Metal not encountered? It is here!

definitions.meaning: take the word for encountered, MET, out of the word Metal and two letters remain
those two letters are the chemical symbol of the element being clued, so the answer is the metal they stand for

explanation.surface: An exclamation of surprise at finding a metal nobody had come across before.
explanation.walkthrough: Metal minus MET leaves AL, which is the chemical symbol of the answer; the solver must know symbols, since the letters of the answer come from no wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Aluminium is a light silvery metallic element, chemical symbol Al, atomic number 13.

clue.text: Augustine's place for a beast

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the ancient North African city where St Augustine was bishop
second meaning: short for hippopotamus, the large African animal

explanation.walkthrough: St Augustine of Hippo was bishop of that city in present-day Algeria; the same word is the shortened name of the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Hippo names both the Roman city Hippo Regius, Augustine's see, and colloquially the hippopotamus.

clue.text: African managed to stow away any number in packing material

indicators.note: the word for managed tucks the rest inside itself, as cargo is stowed in a hold

parts.note: ran, as in ran a business

indicators.note: the number sits inside the packing material

parts.note: a wad is a lump of soft material used for padding or packing
N is the mathematician's symbol for an unspecified number

explanation.surface: An African stowaway who managed to hide among packing material.
explanation.walkthrough: N for any number comes from algebra, as in the nth degree.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rwandan is a native of Rwanda, a country in central Africa.

clue.text: No holy person given booze as a remedy

parts.note: taken as written
ST is the abbreviation for saint
rum is a strong spirit, one kind of booze

explanation.surface: Refusing to give a saint alcohol as a cure.
explanation.definitionFit: A nostrum is a quack medicine or pet scheme offered as a cure-all.

clue.text: Country tricked by leader of Conservatives

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: the word supplies its initial, as the party's leader
had, as in 'you've been had', means fooled

explanation.surface: A nation duped by the head of the Conservative party.
explanation.definitionFit: Chad is a landlocked republic in north-central Africa.

clue.text: Storage space said to be leaky?

indicators.note: the word for storage space is spoken aloud to give a sound-alike

parts.note: a hold is the cargo space in a ship or plane

explanation.surface: Asking whether a storage area lets in water.
explanation.walkthrough: A ship's hold is where cargo is stored; spoken, it sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something holed has a hole pierced in it, so it lets water through, as a holed ship does.

clue.text: Mousy drips — sloppy element

indicators.note: careless and messy, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: the ten letters of these two words are the raw material

explanation.surface: Insulting a dull, wet person as a careless sort.
explanation.definitionFit: Dysprosium is a rare-earth metallic element, atomic number 66, used in magnets.

clue.text: Younger brother who's dispatched cricketer

definitions.meaning: first meaning: Abel, the third human after Adam and Cain, killed by his elder brother
second meaning: a fielder placed behind the batsman on the off side

explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, Abel was the third man created or born and was murdered by Cain. Third man is a fielding position in cricket, deep behind the wicket.
explanation.definitionFit: Abel, the slain younger son, counts as the third human, and the cricket position names the fielder stationed there.

clue.text: Get out residual bit

definitions.meaning: first meaning: in cricket, to dismiss a batsman by the wicketkeeper breaking the wicket
second meaning: the part left, as of a tree or a limb

explanation.walkthrough: Stumping is one way a cricket batsman is out, when the keeper breaks the wicket while the batsman is out of the crease.
explanation.definitionFit: Stump is both the verb for that cricket dismissal and a noun for the remaining stub of something.

clue.text: Playwright of exceptionally classy hue

indicators.note: read as out of the usual way, telling us to rearrange the letters

parts.note: the nine letters of these two words are the raw material

explanation.surface: A dramatist known for an unusually stylish colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Aeschylus was the ancient Greek tragedian, author of the Oresteia.

clue.text: Hell, with the German soldiers being captured in riot?

indicators.note: the soldiers are held between the other parts, like prisoners

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, hence the underworld itself
der is a German form of the
OR stands for other ranks, soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: German troops seized amid hellish violence.
explanation.walkthrough: Dis is a classical name for the underworld; OR (other ranks) is the crossword's standard soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A riot is public disorder, a breakdown of peaceful order.

clue.text: It echoes with no effect? Yes and no!

definitions.meaning: a device that works by sending out waves and picking up their echoes; reversing the word has no effect on it
the reversal both happens and changes nothing, since the word reads the same either way

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about something that bounces back without impact.
explanation.walkthrough: The word reads the same in either direction, so reversing it has no effect; the device itself works by bouncing signals back.
explanation.definitionFit: Radar locates objects by sending out radio waves and detecting their reflections.

clue.text: A rotter with malice worked from a university

parts.note: taken as written
a cad is a man who behaves dishonourably

indicators.note: the letters are worked into a different shape, so rearranged

parts.note: the six letters of this word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A scoundrel's spite crafted at a university.
explanation.definitionFit: Academical is an older adjective form of academic, relating to a college or university.

clue.text: French port with the French leaving boy in wagon

indicators.note: the French article departs, taken out of the port's name

parts.note: Calais, the Channel port
la is a French word for the
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: A boy left behind in a wagon at a French harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A caisson is a two-wheeled military cart carrying ammunition, a kind of wagon.

clue.text: Paying one pound to be in particular environment?

indicators.note: the pound goes inside the surroundings

parts.note: a setting is the surroundings in which something is placed
L stands for a pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Wondering whether paying a pound buys a place in some special setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Settling a bill means paying what is owed.

clue.text: Welsh head talks indistinctly

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a headland near Swansea in south Wales
second meaning: a verb for speaking unclearly

explanation.walkthrough: The Mumbles is a headland and village on Swansea Bay, so 'head' is a headland, not a leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Mumbles names the Welsh promontory and is also the verb for muttering words unclearly.

clue.text: Silly male bishop — wet fool?

indicators.note: the word male is made silly, its letters scrambled

parts.note: the four letters of this word are rearranged
B is the chess notation for bishop
rain is wet weather

explanation.surface: Mocking a foolish male bishop as a drip.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamebrain is a stupid person, a dimwit.

clue.text: Goddess put off embracing yours truly

indicators.note: the word for put off holds the setter's self-reference in its arms

parts.note: to deter is to discourage
the setter refers to themself, so me

explanation.surface: A goddess discouraged from hugging the writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Demeter is the Greek goddess of the harvest and agriculture, mother of Persephone.

clue.text: Philosopher and boxer needing support around

indicators.note: the support goes round the boxer

parts.note: a rest is something that props up, like an armrest
Muhammad Ali, the famous heavyweight

explanation.surface: A thinker and a fighter both needing something to lean on.
explanation.definitionFit: In philosophy a realist holds that objects exist independently of the mind.

clue.text: Nest in a mountain houses this bird

indicators.note: the phrase contains the bird's name within its letters

parts.note: the bird's name runs across the end of nest, all of in and a, and the start of mountain

explanation.surface: A mountain nest that shelters a particular bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The tinamou is a ground-dwelling bird of Central and South America.

clue.text: In match there's nothing that's nasty? That's hard to answer

indicators.note: the nothing and the exclamation go inside the match

parts.note: a tie is a game in a knockout cup competition
O looks like a zero
ugh is an exclamation of disgust

explanation.surface: A cup tie with nothing unpleasant about it, it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: A tie is a match in a knockout competition. The definition hints at this very puzzle series.
explanation.definitionFit: A toughie is a difficult problem or question, hence also the name of this crossword series.

clue.text: Honour director's initiation during dinner?

indicators.note: the letter falls in the middle of the meal

parts.note: dinner is a meal

indicators.note: the start of the word director, its first letter

parts.note: the director's first letter is what is used

explanation.surface: A director's award presented at a dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A medal is a decoration awarded as an honour.

clue.text: Beer here? What fellow drinks is bad, not half!

indicators.note: the fellow takes the shortened word inside, as drink goes into a mouth

parts.note: a don is a university fellow

indicators.note: only half the word for bad is kept

parts.note: evil means wicked

explanation.surface: A beer-drinking fellow and a poor brew.
explanation.walkthrough: Beer is a fishing village in east Devon, so the definition is a place, not a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The county of Devon in south-west England contains the coastal village of Beer.

clue.text: A chum with short dress appearing in port

parts.note: taken as written
bud is an American informal word for a friend

indicators.note: the word loses its last letter, cut short

parts.note: a habit is a form of clothing, as a nun's or riding habit

explanation.surface: A friend wearing a skimpy outfit turns up at a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: Abu Dhabi is the capital of the United Arab Emirates and a major Gulf seaport.

clue.text: Husband, lost for words, sounded hesitant

parts.note: awed means struck dumb with wonder

explanation.surface: A husband, speechless, stammered uncertainly.
explanation.definitionFit: To haw, as in hum and haw, is to make hesitant noises when unsure.

clue.text: Music-maker and storyteller being listened to

indicators.note: heard rather than read, giving a word that sounds alike

parts.note: someone telling stories in the sense of untruths, so a fibber

explanation.surface: A musician and a narrator heard performing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Storyteller' is euphemistic: telling stories means telling lies.
explanation.definitionFit: A lyre is an ancient stringed instrument, so it makes music.

clue.text: Scientist with very short aim, one needing external money

indicators.note: the money must sit outside the other pieces

parts.note: cash is money in notes and coins
V is the short form of very
an end is a purpose or goal
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A scientist with a brief goal who needs outside funding.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry Cavendish was the English chemist and physicist who identified hydrogen and weighed the earth.

clue.text: Yen to go to river, in need of refreshment?

parts.note: the Wear is a river in north-east England, through Durham

explanation.surface: Longing to visit a river for a refreshing drink.
explanation.walkthrough: The Wear is a river in County Durham, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone weary is tired and needs rest or refreshing.

clue.text: Style and vigour, first to last, shows the way

indicators.note: the opening letter moves to the end of the word

parts.note: elan is flair and energy

explanation.surface: Flair and energy, from start to finish, point the route.
explanation.definitionFit: A lane is a narrow road or path, a way to travel along.

clue.text: Gate at social event allowing number in

indicators.note: the outer pieces permit something to come among them
the number goes inside, between the two outer pieces

parts.note: taken as written
a dance is a social gathering
ten is a number

explanation.surface: An entrance at a party that lets some people through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gate' is the sports sense: the number of spectators at a match, not a barrier.
explanation.definitionFit: A gate is the crowd count at a sports fixture, the attendance.
